text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon has truly become the top Umadol. Her popularity is extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Are you dumb?! Bubblegum pop obviously suits Falco the best!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No you idiot, Falco's pure and noble
spirit is her
defining trait. It's all about
bold songs that express both her beauty
and strength!

It appears her increasing number of
passionate
fans don't always agree with
each other...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey now! Don't fight over me!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Falco?!
Smart Falcon?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm super happy that you're
thinking of
me so much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But everyone has their own ideas about
what an
Umadol is, and everyone is free
to support me
however they like!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: But this fool just doesn't get you... No, you don't get her!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I get it.
There are some things you just
can't
budge on, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But if you feel like that, shoot those
feelings my
way!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
The next day...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Here I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!

A crowd of fans, including the ones who
were arguing, gathers on campus after
we hurriedly get
permission from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I heard there was an event,
but... it's just
running?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Is she not singing? I wanted to see her
sing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay! Quiet, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Attention, everyooone! ☆ I'm gonna run
now, so
you'd better not blink or you'll
miss it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Readyyyyy... GO! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh! ☆

And so, Smart Falcon sets off running
along the
track by herself. Initially, the
fans are confused,
but...

Before long, something strange starts to
happen.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? I... I can hear something... A song!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's... "UNLIMITED IMPACT"?! I can feel
the
beauty and strength of an
undisputed champion!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Not only that! It's innocent joy mixed
with bubbly
cuteness... I can hear "Make
Debut!" with my
heart!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Is there anything she can't do?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
You're the best, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your support, everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ It looks like my feelings
reached you
all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm standing center stage in each
and every
one of your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's a Falco inside you, and a Falco
inside
you... and all of those Falcos are
different
because they're yours!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry! I won't betray any of
them.
Why? Because I'm the top
Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right then!
Let's try a little call and

response! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo-hoo! L-O-V-E! We love
Falcooo!

In a single run, Smart Falcon manages to
unite the
hearts of her fans. She truly
embodies the
concept of a top Umadol.
